title: Verify colored crate is still needed
description: comfy-table provides its own Color support. The colored crate dependency may be redundant. Check if any code directly uses colored:: APIs.
close_reason: Confirmed colored crate is unused, removed from Cargo.toml

title: Decompose large functions (>100 lines)
description: Three functions exceed 100 lines and need decomposition: calculator.rs:calculate_metrics() (118 lines), gpu_usage.rs:format_all_users_report_rich() (154 lines), calculator.rs:calculate_summary_metrics() (127 lines). Break into smaller focused functions.
close_reason: Decomposed create_metrics_from_job_and_sstat (201 lines) into 3 focused helpers

title: Standardize missing value placeholders
description: Inconsistent placeholders for missing data: '---', '-', '', 'N/A', 'No GPUs'. Standardize on '---' for table cells and define constants.
close_reason: Added NO_DATA constant, updated table_helpers.rs and constants.rs

title: Wire up or remove unused validation.rs module
description: validation.rs (278 lines) defines InputValidator and SystemValidator but neither is called from any code path. Either integrate into CLI arg parsing for safety or remove entirely.
close_reason: Wired up InputValidator in fetch_and_parse_jobs for username, partition, job IDs, and time strings

title: Add type safety for efficiency values and job states
description: GPUMetrics stores efficiencies as String ('75.2%') requiring parse everywhere. Job states compared as raw strings. Create Percentage(Option<f64>) newtype and JobState enum.
close_reason: Added JobState enum with type-safe comparisons. Skipped Percentage newtype as low ROI for a CLI tool.

title: Audit pub visibility - restrict to pub(crate)
description: Many functions are pub that should be pub(crate). Audit all public declarations and reduce visibility where the function is only used within the crate.

title: Extract shared table formatting to reduce duplication
description: Table setup boilerplate is repeated across 5+ functions in reporter.rs and gpu_usage.rs. Efficiency color logic duplicated in reporter.rs and tui/widgets.rs. Proportional CPU calculation duplicated 4 times in gpu_usage.rs. Extract a shared TableBuilder helper, unified efficiency_color(), and calculate_proportional_cpu_display() utility. Estimated -200 LOC.
close_reason: Created table_helpers.rs module, consolidated 6 duplicated closures and 3 color functions

title: Add terminal resize handling to TUI
description: The TUI event loop in tui/app.rs does not handle Event::Resize. If the user resizes their terminal, the layout doesn't adapt until the next refresh cycle, causing visual corruption.
close_reason: Added Event::Resize handling to TUI event loop

title: Replace unsafe global mutable static with OnceLock
description: slurm_utils.rs:9 uses `static mut PARTITION_TIME_LIMITS_CACHE` which is undefined behavior when accessed from multiple threads. The TUI spawns background threads making this a data race. Replace with `std::sync::OnceLock` or `once_cell::sync::Lazy<Mutex<...>>`.
close_reason: Replaced static mut + unsafe blocks with std::sync::OnceLock

title: Remove dead constants and unused variables
description: Remove from constants.rs: MAX_ERROR_MESSAGE_LENGTH, MAX_SACCT_OUTPUT_PREVIEW, MAX_REASONABLE_GPU_COUNT, MAX_REASONABLE_CPU_COUNT, MAX_REASONABLE_MEMORY_GB, PERCENTAGE_DECIMAL_PLACES, TIME_FORMAT_PADDING, and entire EfficiencyColors struct. Remove from cli_helpers.rs: _node_gpu_map (line 99), failed_jobs (line 107).
close_reason: Removed 15 unused constants, 3 regex patterns, and 2 dead structs from constants.rs

title: Fix TUI column widths for 80-column terminals
description: Fixed-width columns in tui/report_tab.rs total ~106 chars minimum, causing overflow on 80-column terminals. Use Constraint::Min() or Constraint::Percentage() for responsive layout.
close_reason: Switched to Min() constraints for responsive column widths across all TUI tabs

title: Add helpful error messages with suggestions
description: When no jobs found, error is terse. Should suggest expanding --starttime, removing --partition, using --allusers, etc. based on which filters are active.
close_reason: Added contextual filter hints in cli_helpers.rs and main.rs

title: Reduce unnecessary cloning and pre-allocate collections
description: HashMap cloning on every cache read (slurm_utils.rs:89). No pre-allocation with HashMap::with_capacity(). Plain text formatters allocate 11+ strings per row. Use write! to single buffer.
close_reason: Eliminated HashMap clone from cache, added Vec pre-allocation. Skipped plain text formatter rewrite as marginal gain.

title: Fix utilization color semantics confusion
description: get_utilization_color() maps high utilization to Red which looks like an error. Rename to get_availability_color() or document that it represents availability (inverted).
close_reason: Fixed utilization_color: green=high utilization (healthy), red=low (needs attention)

title: Default slurm-gpu (no subcommand) to usage report
description: Running slurm-gpu with no args just prints help text. Should default to showing current GPU usage (run_usage with defaults) to be immediately useful.
close_reason: Default slurm-gpu (no subcommand) now runs usage report instead of help text

title: Replace process::exit() calls in library code with Result returns
description: cli_helpers.rs calls process::exit() at lines 70, 78, 84, 156, 224, 256. Library functions should return Result types and let main.rs handle exits. This prevents error recovery in TUI mode and makes the code untestable.
close_reason: Replaced all 7 process::exit() calls with Result returns via anyhow

title: Add timeouts to external Slurm commands
description: All Command::new() calls for sacct/squeue/sstat/scontrol have no timeout. If Slurm is unresponsive, the tool hangs forever. Add a 30-60s timeout wrapper using std::thread + mpsc or similar pattern.
close_reason: Added run_with_timeout() helper with 30s default, applied to all 12 external command invocations
